name: Autodromo Internazionale del Mugello
layout: Full circuit, clockwise (5.245 km, 15 turns) as used by TCR Europe 2026 round 1

sources.geometry: OpenStreetMap raceway ways (corners tagged ref 1-14: San Donato ... Bucine) graph-routed in race order; pit lane, Bypass and Mugellino excluded.
sources.width: Published: 14 m total track width (MotoGP.com circuit info https://www.motogp.com/en/event/Italy, Tech3 track data https://2022.tech3racing.fr/index.php/en/gran-premio-d-italia, Pirelli track days). An attempt to measure from AGEA/PCN Ortofoto 2012 (~0.35 m/px) gave inconsistent edge-line pairs (~10-14 m); Regione Toscana OFC 2022 20 cm is licensed without download rights, so not used.
sources.elevation: INGV TINITALY 1.1 10 m DEM via WCS (https://tinitaly.pi.ingv.it/TINItaly_1_1/wcs, coverage TINItaly_1_1__tinitaly_dem, EPSG:32632); extra ~100 m smoothing on top of the trackkit dtm profile; cross-checked with Copernicus GLO-30 (agreement within ~3 m, range 245-287 m, i.e. the known ~41 m difference). Regione Toscana LiDAR 1 m DTM only available via interactive cartoteca download.
sources.pit: OSM raceway way 197788411 "Pit Lane" (maxspeed 60), entry after Bucine, exit before San Donato
sources.trim: Fast, flowing corners plus a 1.1 km main straight: slightly less downforce/drag than Spa
sources.pitLimit: TCR: 60 km/h, 2026 TCR Europe Sporting Regulations art. 94 (https://europe.tcr-series.com/pdf/2026_TCR_Europe_Sporting_Regs_V3_final.pdf)
sources.layout: TCR Europe 2026 calendar, round 1 Mugello 20-22 March (https://europe.tcr-series.com/index.php/news/item/tcr-europe-confirms-a-thrilling-new-calendar-for-2026); length 5.245 km

notes: Start/finish line is not mapped in OSM; station 0 placed on the main straight opposite the covered main grandstand/race control (43.9977, 11.3718), uncertain by ~50 m. Width is the uniform published 14 m. Turns numbered per the official 15-turn map (Biondetti counted as T13/T14). GT4 European Series does not race here in 2026; pitLoss for TCR unknown.
